title: Congressional hearings on military reports of Unexplained Aerial Phenomena (UAP) - May 17th, 2022
description: House Intelligence Subcommittee on Counterterrorism, Counterintelligence, Counterproliferation held Congressional hearings with top military officials to discuss military reports of Unexplained Aerial Phenomena (UAP). It was the first public congressional hearing into UFO sightings in the US in over 50 years.
